_why: A registered title that is wrong would be printed wrong. An override here is narrow and checked: check_references.py applies it only while the registered title is still the string recorded in 'registered', so if the publisher corrects the record the gate says so instead of silently keeping a stale correction. The DOI is never changed.

10.1364/boe.8.000679.registered: aLow-dose CT via convolutional neural network
10.1364/boe.8.000679.display: Low-dose CT via convolutional neural network
10.1364/boe.8.000679.source: The Crossref record carries a stray leading 'a'. PubMed (Europe PMC, DOI:10.1364/boe.8.000679, checked 2026-11-02) and the article itself give 'Low-dose CT via convolutional neural network', Biomed Opt Express 2017;8(2):679-694.
